cells.gaps: The stations facts disagree. 76 stations in and around Nairobi held a connected digital Occurrence Book on 30 June 2023 (KEN-034), and the Uasin Gishu police commander said in March 2026 that it had been rolled out at five Eldoret stations (KEN-050). The Inspector General told MPs in May 2026 that the service did not yet have digital Occurrence Books (KEN-002), and in August 2026 the Interior Cabinet Secretary announced them for all 1,200 stations by the end of 2026 (KEN-051); the newest stations fact stands. The case file is a commitment only (KEN-019); no plan value and no domestic budget line have been found.
cells.note: The newest stations fact, the Inspector General's of May 2026, says no station yet has the digital Occurrence Book, so rung 3 is not reached on it. The five Eldoret stations of March 2026 would meet rung 3 if that statement were set aside.
